title: GA4GH AI Registry: MCP server entry (v1)
description: The common entry core plus an embedded, verbatim, valid server.json document, validated against schemas/vendor/server.schema.json (internal project documentation Section 3.5.4). All GA4GH additions live inside server._meta['org.ga4gh/ai-registry'], the upstream schema's own sanctioned extension point, so the embedded server document remains lift-out-able: stripping that one key MUST leave a valid, unmodified server.json publishable to registry.modelcontextprotocol.io. server.packages[] and server.remotes[] already cover any externally hosted distribution mechanism (an npm/PyPI/OCI/NuGet registry package, a direct-download URL, or a remote streamable-http/SSE endpoint), so this schema adds no separate hosting field.

org.ga4gh/ai-registry.description: The sole GA4GH extension point inside the embedded server.json document (internal project documentation Section 3.5.4). Every GA4GH addition lives here, never as a sibling key on the server document itself.

ga4gh_standards.description: Which GA4GH API specification(s) this server implements, and at what version, e.g. "trs@2.0.1". A bare kebab-case identifier with an optional @version suffix whose version part starts with a digit, so "trs@v2.0.1" is not a second spelling of "trs@2.0.1". This is the precise implementation claim; the common core's ga4gh_standards[] is the coarse, version-free browse facet. scripts/validate.ts enforces that stripping the @version suffix from every item here yields a subset of the common core array.

safety_classification.description: Same shape as the common core's safety_classification[] (internal project documentation Section 3.3).

duo.description: Optional Data Use Ontology / consent metadata associated with data this server exposes.
